# Mindat

> A comprehensive mineralogical database and reference tool for mineral identification, classification, and properties including radioactivity measurements and elemental data.

Mindat provides searchable databases and reference tools for mineralogists, collectors, and researchers to identify minerals by physical properties, chemical composition, and radioactivity levels. The site integrates mineral classification systems (Dana, Strunz), elemental information, and radiation measurement data.

## Key Topics

- Mineral identification
- Radioactivity database
- Mineral properties
- Dana classification
- Strunz classification
- Radioactive minerals
- Becquerel and Curie units
- Rare Earth Elements
- Element properties
- Radiation measurement
- Mineral color classification
- Chemical reference
- Calculated activity
- Webmineral
- Jmol visualization

## Mineral Identification & Classification

- [Red Colored Minerals](http://webmin.mindat.org/determin/color.php?color_search=Red): Mineral identification tool filtering by red color, luster, and streak

## Radioactivity Reference

- [Radioactivity Database](http://webmin.mindat.org/determin/radioactivity.php): Searchable database of minerals classified by calculated radioactivity levels

## Chemical & Elemental Reference

- [Berkelium Element Properties](http://webmin.mindat.org/chem/Chem-Bk.htm): Berkelium element properties and discovery information reference
